title: Quote Worksheet for the Estimated Final Statement Prepayment — Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
**Calculation.** A resident whose Utility Pass-Through Service account has a service end date may prepay the estimated final statement, and the prepayment quoted is the current utility balance plus the estimated final statement. The estimated final statement is the projected usage charge, plus the fixed charges quoted for the final cycle, plus one administration fee at the schedule's amount. The projected usage charge is the projected final-cycle consumption priced at the average unit price of the latest water usage charge, that charge's amount divided by the consumption it billed, and rounded half up to the cent. The projected final-cycle consumption is the projected daily use times the days from the date of the latest water read on the account to the service end date, counted by subtracting the earlier date from the later. The projected daily use for a final-statement prepayment is the average consumption of the actual water reads taken in the last four months divided by 30, a read counting as taken in the last four months when fewer than four whole months separate its read date from the handling date. The fixed charges quoted for the final cycle are one whole month of the fixed charges billed on the latest statement, which are the fixed charges dated in the last whole month. The prepayment is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final sum.

## Worksheet lines

| Line | Quantity | How it is found |
|---|---|---|
| A | Current utility balance | The account's utility balance now (a credit balance is a negative figure) |
| B | Projected daily use | Average consumption of the actual water reads dated fewer than 4 whole months before the handling date, divided by 30 |
| C | Days to the service end date | Service end date less the date of the latest water read on the account |
| D | Projected final-cycle consumption | B times C |
| E | Average unit price | Amount of the latest water usage charge divided by the consumption it billed (not rounded) |
| F | Projected usage charge | D times E, rounded half up to the cent |
| G | Fixed charges for the final cycle | Total of the fixed charges dated fewer than one whole month before the handling date |
| H | Administration fee | One administration fee at the schedule's amount |
| I | Estimated final statement | F plus G plus H |
| J | Prepayment quoted | A plus I, rounded half up to the cent once |

## Worked quote (hypothetical, Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule; administration fee 3.25)

Handling date 10 June; service end date 30 June; latest water read 25 May; current utility balance 74.16.

- B: actual water reads of 4.20, 3.90, 4.50 and 4.20 kgal in the last 4 months total 16.80; their average 4.20, divided by 30, is 0.14 kgal a day.
- C: 25 May to 30 June is 36 days. D: 0.14 times 36 is 5.04 kgal.
- E: the latest water usage charge was 33.62 for 4.20 kgal, about 8.0048 per kgal. F: 5.04 times that price is 40.344, so 40.34.
- G: fixed charges dated in the last whole month — water base 10.62, sewer base 12.40, trash 19.40 — total 42.42.
- I: 40.34 plus 42.42 plus 3.25 is 86.01.
- J: 74.16 plus 86.01 is **160.17**.
